name: year offset range no duplicate base years
description: Verifies that year_offset range columns do not expand base_years and do not produce a redundant LEFT JOIN when no WHERE filter exists on the offset column
expected_query: with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2024,2025,2026]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('RB')), "td58a581a64349ce01594aad40d276a38" as materialized (select COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid) as pid, "nfl_plays"."season_year" as "year", SUM(CASE WHEN ball_carrier_pid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rush_atts_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2024) group by "nfl_plays"."season_year", COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid)), "t2ae283b15150b10efb81d48d77b576d9" as materialized (select COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid) as pid, "nfl_plays"."season_year" as "year", SUM(CASE WHEN ball_carrier_pid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rush_atts_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2025, 2026) group by "nfl_plays"."season_year", COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid)) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "td58a581a64349ce01594aad40d276a38"."rush_atts_from_plays" AS "rush_atts_from_plays_0", (SELECT SUM(t2ae283b15150b10efb81d48d77b576d9.rush_atts_from_plays) FROM "rush_atts_from_plays_1", "player_years"."year", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join
